privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How we handle the information you choose to share.
privacy.controller: COOHOSTY is responsible for information submitted through this site. For privacy requests, contact {email}. Full legal entity details must be completed before commercial launch.
privacy.data: We collect the contact, property, operational, authorization and objective details you submit, optional property images, consent timestamps and request status. Admin sessions and security rate-limit identifiers are also stored.
privacy.purpose: We use your information to review your property, reply to your inquiry and provide requested services. Submission requires your consent. We do not sell your information.
privacy.providers: PostgreSQL stores requests. Cloudinary stores optional images with restricted delivery. Resend sends confirmation and notification emails. Vercel may host the application. These providers may process data outside Morocco; required transfer and regulatory formalities must be assessed before launch. When enabled, PriceLabs processes the property address and bedroom count for a local rental income benchmark; contact details are not sent to PriceLabs.
privacy.retention: The default retention policy is {retentionDays} days after the last update, unless a service relationship or legal obligation requires longer retention. Contact us to request access, correction or deletion, or to withdraw consent. The operator must review applicable Moroccan data protection requirements and CNDP formalities before launch.
privacy.storage: With your choice to use the form, a draft is stored locally on this device to preserve progress. It is cleared after successful submission or when you select clear saved progress. Avoid using shared devices. Admin cookies are essential for secure authentication; no analytics or advertising cookies are installed.

faq.title: Your questions. Answered.
faq.description: The essentials before entrusting us with your property.

plans.question: Which plan is right for my property?
plans.answer: AUDIT identifies opportunities to improve. OPTIMIZE adds revenue management while you handle guests. COHOST adds booking management and guest communication. If you are unsure, select “I don’t know” in the form.

price.question: How is pricing determined?
price.answer: All plans are quoted individually. Pricing depends on your property, its situation and the scope of support. Services, tools and any additional fees are specified before you commit.

guarantees.question: Do you guarantee higher revenue or five-star reviews?
guarantees.answer: No. We work on performance opportunities and the quality of the stay without guaranteeing revenue, occupancy or ratings. Results depend on the market, the property and the experience guests actually have.

remote.question: Can I work with you from abroad?
remote.answer: Yes. The form and our conversations allow us to assess your property remotely. The scope and arrangements are defined according to your needs and your property’s situation.

platforms.question: How do you support Airbnb hosts?
platforms.answer: We assess and optimize your Airbnb listings, then coordinate reservations, guests and cleaning according to your plan. COOHOSTY is an independent service with no affiliation to Airbnb.

onSite.question: Are cleaning, photography and on-site check-in included?
onSite.answer: The comparison covers photo assessment and check-in/out communication. A photo shoot, cleaning, maintenance or physical check-in are not automatically included. Any on-site intervention must be confirmed in your quote.

start.question: What happens after I request an audit?
start.answer: You submit your property information and preferred plan. Our team reviews the request and contacts you to clarify your needs and propose an appropriate scope.

data.question: How do you use my information and photographs?
data.answer: They are used to assess your request and contact you, with your consent. Our privacy policy explains the processing arrangements and your rights.
